title: Stage 2a exact two-member pre-launch assignment (draft)
description: A signs this additive assignment after the existing one-use reservation and private bridge assignment, before either member child is launched. The sorted members must equal the measured frozen SoulInfo.json and host projection. This record does not assert a future child process, B readiness, ACP initialization or physical result.

owner_plan_member_set_sha256.description: SHA-256 of exact RFC 8785 JCS bytes of the stable sorted member projection (member_id, role, adapter_id, adapter_version, command_path, command_sha256, adjacent_cli_path, adjacent_cli_sha256), explicitly selected by the authenticated owner-reviewed installed plan. A refuses if that plan field is absent or differs; measured SoulInfo alone cannot authorize this cohort.

reservation_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact existing A-signed one-use reservation envelope bytes.

b_authority.description: Existing A-signed B authority: the protected reservation itself or the distinct cooperative private B assignment. No new B listener or account is implied.

frozen_soul_info_sha256.description: SHA-256 of exact frozen SoulInfo.json file bytes in the measured definition snapshot.

adapter_manifest_relpath.description: Relative path to the frozen measured adapter source declaration. A reads this exact file from its definition snapshot, never from an R-supplied path.

frozen_adapter_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of exact raw bytes at adapter_manifest_relpath, checked against A's measured definition snapshot. The declaration is not a release signature.

host_projection_sha256.description: SHA-256 of exact RFC 8785 JCS bytes of the measured launch-input host_projection object.

bridge.description: One existing B account and the three existing approved endpoints for the whole Soul. Per-member selectors do not create new listeners or authority.

members.description: Exactly the frozen two-member set, strictly ascending by member_id UTF-8 bytes with no duplicate IDs, launch IDs or selectors. ACP command path comes from measured host projection; its basename and digest must match the frozen adapter manifest. The adjacent CLI path is its sibling, using the manifest's adjacent_cli basename and digest. Consumers enforce these cross-source and cross-item rules.

approvedEndpoint.description: Exact existing protected or cooperative endpoint object. The profile-specific reservation and B authority determine which form is permitted.

member_selector.description: Non-bearer selector: mb_ plus SHA-256 hex of UTF-8 purpose agent-bot/stage2a-member-selector/v1, NUL, reservation_sha256 ASCII, NUL, member_id UTF-8, NUL, launch_id ASCII. It never substitutes for a kernel PID/start check.
